title: Energy System Simulator
description:
A transparent, optimisation-based simulator for an electrical energy system with renewable generation, dispatchable thermal plants, storage, reservoir hydro, demand response, imports, distribution constraints, and hourly end-user consumption.

The model is designed for research, teaching, and policy experiments. It uses explicit physical and economic constraints rather than machine-learning methods. Capabilities include multi-unit thermal unit commitment, solar and wind asset models, battery and pumped-storage dispatch, reservoir and run-of-river hydro, sector demand response and flexible electrification, nodal DC dispatch with N-1 security checks, frequency adequacy proxies, AC power-flow validation, rolling-horizon simulation, Monte Carlo reliability studies, stochastic dispatch, market settlement, capacity expansion, and standalone distribution-feeder, hydrogen, and district-heat studies. Dispatch is solved as a mixed-integer programme with scipy.optimize.milp, and results are reported as versioned CSV tables, JSON summary metrics, manifests, diagnostic plots, and a dashboard.
